metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities, dye spectra from Kodak Alaris E-4000 (rev. 8-18), KODAK PROFESSIONAL EKTACHROME Film E100, Process E-6, Status A. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its order at the dense end, and converted from Status A densities into dye amounts with the sheet's dye spectra and the base density of the agx reference profile 'kodak_ektachrome_100'. Exposure axis aligned to 'kodak_ektachrome_100' at the D-min + 1.0 speed point (offset +0.852 decades). Layer speeds set so a grey views neutral from three stops under mid-grey to two over: red -0.026, blue +0.063 decades against green; the curves are otherwise as drawn. The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. Base density, Hanatos-2025 adaptation parameters, DIR couplers inherited from 'kodak_ektachrome_100', which shares this stock's dye set and process.
